intro.text: A rare metal, first called ettmetal, that keeps southern airships aloft and charges their cubes. Wax and Steris study it in Elendel, trying to pull it apart into atium and lerasium.
A rare, soft metal that keeps southern airships aloft and charges their cubes. Drawn apart under electric heat, it starts to turn into atium and lerasium, and it pushes trellium away.

description.text: Paired with southern technology, the metal grants Allomantic or Feruchemical powers to those near it. Small primer cubes hold it and switch its effect on or off; used Allomantically it burns a pure white and is slowly used up. It drives Steelpushing airships and blue lamps. The cubes are scarce, as the metal is tightly controlled.
Northerners call the charged cubes Allomantic grenades. Once Wax, Marasi and others dealt often with the Malwish, they gained more cubes for police work, and the design was improved.

items.text: It melts only above 3,000 degrees, and heated, it shines with every colour of light, its red and infrared end running past the scale.
It corrodes and reacts strongly with air, so it is kept under oil. Acids leave it untouched.
Too much of it in one place is said to risk forming a perpendicularity, so the southerners never store large amounts together.

It is soft like gold, more so when heated by flame or electricity. Drawn slowly apart under electric heat, a nugget begins to separate into two parts resembling atium and lerasium, but both revert once the thread between them is cut.
It and trellium repel each other, more strongly the closer they are forced together.

Trellium set between two halves of a softened, split piece sets off a violent reaction that turns a small part of both metals into pure energy, leaving bits of atium and lerasium. The blast is akin to a nuclear bomb, and even Harmony and Autonomy do not know how strong it could be.
